# Scenario schema reference

Scenario format of baton v1 (docs/ru/spec.md, section 3). Step kinds the runner does not execute yet are accepted as objects and gain their fields in the milestone that implements them.

Generated from the JSON Schema that `baton schema` prints, so it always describes the format this build accepts.

## scenario

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `1` | yes |  |
| `name` | string | no |  |
| `description` | string | no |  |
| `inputs` | map of name to [input](#input) | no |  |
| `defaults` | object | no |  |
| `budget` | object | no |  |
| `secrets` | map of name to [secret](#secret) | no |  |
| `apis` | map of name to [api](#api) | no |  |
| `commands` | map of name to [command](#command) | no |  |
| `steps` | array of [step](#step) | yes | At least items: 1. |
| `on_failure` | array of [step](#step) | no |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### scenario.defaults

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `engine` | string | no |  |
| `model` | string | no |  |
| `timeout` | [duration](#duration) | no |  |
| `budget_usd` | number | no | Minimum 0. |

No other fields are allowed.

### scenario.budget

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `usd` | number | no | Minimum 0. |
| `time` | [duration](#duration) | no |  |

No other fields are allowed.

## Definitions

### duration

A Go duration string such as 10m, or a number of seconds.

Type: string or number

### size

A byte count, optionally with a k, m or g suffix in powers of 1024.

Type: string or integer

### template

A string that may contain {{ }} template actions. Templates are text/template and escape nothing: pipe a value through html wherever the output is HTML. A missing key renders as an empty value instead of an error, so guard the fields you rely on with default or an assert step. A path passed to render is resolved against the directory of the scenario file, unlike the paths of a file step, which are resolved against the workspace.

Type: string

### input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string`, `int`, `number`, `bool`, `list`, `map` | no |  |
| `required` | boolean | no |  |
| `default` | any | no |  |
| `pattern` | string | no | Format `regex`. |

No other fields are allowed.

### secret

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | `env`, `file` | yes |  |
| `key` | string | no |  |
| `path` | string | no |  |
| `trim` | boolean | no |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### api

An apis entry: a pack, its source, configuration and authorisation (spec section 7.4.1).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `interface` | string | no | Pattern `^[a-z][\w-]*/v[0-9]+$`. |
| `pack` | [template](#template) | yes |  |
| `from` | string | yes |  |
| `sha256` | string | no | Pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`. |
| `config` | map of name to [template](#template) | no |  |
| `auth` | object | no | The secret feeding the authorisation scheme of the pack (spec section 7.4.1). A step overrides it with the plain secret name in http.auth. |
| `timeout` | [duration](#duration) | no |  |

No other fields are allowed.

#### api.auth

The secret feeding the authorisation scheme of the pack (spec section 7.4.1). A step overrides it with the plain secret name in http.auth.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `secret` | string | yes |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### step

A step-body with the id rule of section 3.2: every step needs one, except a switch, which carries none of its own.

Type: [step-body](#step-body)

### step-body

The fields of a step without the id rule, so that a foreach body (spec section 3.7), which has no id of its own, can reuse it.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | no | Pattern `^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$`. |
| `when` | string | no |  |
| `needs` | array of string | no |  |
| `timeout` | [duration](#duration) | no |  |
| `retry` | [retry](#retry) | no |  |
| `on_error` | `fail`, `continue`, `fallback` | no |  |
| `fallback` | [step](#step) | no |  |
| `cache` | boolean | no |  |
| `dedupe_key` | [template](#template) | no |  |
| `message` | [template](#template) | no |  |
| `run` | [run](#run) | no |  |
| `http` | [http](#http) | no |  |
| `assert` | [assert](#assert) | no |  |
| `llm` | [llm](#llm) | no |  |
| `agent` | [agent](#agent) | no |  |
| `foreach` | [foreach](#foreach) | no |  |
| `until` | [until](#until) | no |  |
| `file` | [file](#file) | no |  |
| `switch` | string | no | Subject expression of a switch; sugar over when, expanded at load (spec section 3.10). |
| `cases` | map of name to [step](#step) | no | One step per value of the switch subject. At least fields: 1. |
| `default` | [step](#step) | no | Step taken when no case matches. |
| `notify` | string | no | Name of a channel of the global configuration; the text comes from message (spec section 9.3). |

No other fields are allowed.

### agent

Hands a prompt to an agent engine that works via tool calls until it submits a result (spec section 3.6).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `engine` | `claude-code`, `codex`, `fake` | yes |  |
| `model` | string | no |  |
| `prompt` | [template](#template) | yes |  |
| `system` | [template](#template) | no |  |
| `with` | map of name to [template](#template) | no |  |
| `skills` | array of string | no |  |
| `profile` | `review`, `fix`, `research` | no |  |
| `tools` | [tools](#tools) | no |  |
| `limits` | [limits](#limits) | no |  |
| `max_turns` | integer | no | Minimum 0. |
| `budget_usd` | number | no | Minimum 0. |
| `allow_unsafe` | boolean | no |  |
| `env` | map of name to [template](#template) or object | no |  |
| `inherit_auth` | boolean | no | Reuse the credentials the CLI stored in the user's home directory instead of an API key from env, so a subscription login works (spec section 8.2); supported by the codex engine only. |
| `result` | string | yes |  |
| `script` | string | no | The fake engine's behaviour file (spec section 8.4); rejected for any engine other than fake. |

No other fields are allowed.

Caps how much an agent step may ask of the gateway (spec section 7.3).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_tool_calls` | integer | no | Minimum 0. |
| `max_result_bytes` | [size](#size) | no |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### foreach

Runs its body once per item of a list (spec section 3.7).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | [template](#template) | yes |  |
| `as` | string | no |  |
| `max_parallel` | integer | no | Minimum 0. |
| `on_item_error` | `fail`, `continue` | no |  |
| `min_success` | number | no | Minimum 0, Maximum 1. |
| `step` | [step-body](#step-body) | yes | The per-item body; it has no id of its own. |

No other fields are allowed.

### until

Repeats its body until the condition holds (spec section 3.8).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `condition` | string | yes | Checked after every iteration, with that iteration in iter. |
| `max_iterations` | integer | yes | Minimum 1. |
| `step` | [step-body](#step-body) | yes | The per-iteration body; it has no id of its own. |

No other fields are allowed.

### file

Reads, writes, appends or lists files inside the workspace. Exactly one of read, write, append and glob is set.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `read` | [template](#template) | no | Workspace-relative path to read. |
| `write` | [template](#template) | no | Workspace-relative path to write; replaces the file's content. |
| `append` | [template](#template) | no | Workspace-relative path to append to; created if it does not exist. |
| `glob` | [template](#template) | no | Pattern matched against workspace-relative paths. |
| `content` | [template](#template) | no | Text written by write and append. |
| `parse` | `text`, `json`, `lines` | no | Read only: how the file's content becomes the step result. |
| `max_bytes` | [size](#size) | no | Read only: largest file the step accepts, 1MiB by default; a bigger file is an error. |

No other fields are allowed.

### run

A command executed without a shell (spec section 3.3). The bare string form is split by baton and reported as a warning.

Type: string or object

| `argv` | array of [template](#template) | yes | At least items: 1. |
| `cwd` | [template](#template) | no |  |

| `stdin` | [template](#template) | no |  |
| `parse` | `text`, `json`, `lines` | no |  |
| `allow_exit_codes` | array of integer | no |  |
| `max_output_bytes` | [size](#size) | no |  |
| `readonly` | boolean | no |  |

No other fields are allowed.
